title: Super Princess Peach - Glacier Globe, Beanstalk and Rockhead
description:
These sprites appear in Worlds 1, 4 and 6 of Super Princess Peach. For the Glacier Globe, it can be used as a
Trampoline Block
https://www.smwcentral.net/?p=section&a=details&id=10296
, while the Rockhead can be used multiple ways. Be cautious when using the Beanstalk, as the leaves sides don't have full interaction, it can also work as a climbing ladder.

Rykon-V73 Edit: Optimized Rockhead and Glacier Globe better to use more of its original animations.
